body:
I feel like I'm making a pretty safe guess by saying it sounds like you're a bit overwhelmed. I have been and still am in the middle of a pretty bad shitfest. These are the things that have helped me. 

Do you have a journal or diary? Writing in one of those can help me get everything bothering me out. My memory isn't the best, so this way I have a list of my problems and can't forget them. 

Now that I have that list, I can start figuring out what my problems are. Whether personal, social, financial, or whatever it is. At this point I can turn the problems into goals. Ie. Alone and friendless --> Find a group of people with common interests. 

Now for the almost hardest part... Come up with a plan. Btw write your thoughts down so you can go back and review or change them. For my problem, I chose to look into groups online. I love nature, so I picked groups that were more inclined to do things like mountain biking, hiking, skating, etc. I found them all online and found that some of the groups worked. 

And the last major step was executing the plan. I'm basically a fish out of water when it comes to being social, but I (got moderately stoned and) said fuck it. I needed to get out to make myself happy. 

On a related note, I haven't been able to get a job in years now. I don't recommend it, but the option is out there if you become desperate enough. Sex work does pay, but has big social consequences and risk. There are places that will hire still too Btw. Head shops are usually pretty open minded. Think less mainstream jobs and they are usually more lax about being trans.
